commands.name: doctor
commands.notes: Read-only. Reports Docker, images, cache, OpenBao reachability and policy state.

exit_codes.name: ok
exit_codes.meaning: Command completed and every check passed.

exit_codes.name: subject_failed
exit_codes.meaning: The system under test failed: failing tests, failing assertions, a detected responsive defect. Infrastructure worked.

exit_codes.name: usage
exit_codes.meaning: Invalid command, option or argument. Nothing was started.

exit_codes.name: environment
exit_codes.meaning: A precondition is missing: Docker unavailable, pinned image absent, cache or run directory unwritable, OpenBao unreachable. Nothing ran.

exit_codes.name: policy_refused
exit_codes.meaning: The request violates a binding decision and was refused before any container started (disallowed mount, Docker socket, privileged, secret in arguments, unapproved target, mutating action).

exit_codes.name: timeout
exit_codes.meaning: The run exceeded its time limit and its container was stopped and removed.

exit_codes.name: internal
exit_codes.meaning: dev-test or its runner failed unexpectedly. The result is not evidence about the subject.

exit_codes.name: cleanup_incomplete
exit_codes.meaning: The run finished but a container, volume or workspace could not be removed. Reported, never ignored.

exit_codes.name: interrupted
exit_codes.meaning: Interrupted by signal. Containers were stopped and removed.
